---
title: Cheese Stuffed Puff Pastry Discs
id: MAR-0071
lang: en
source_lang: it
servings: 4
time_min: 60
difficulty: medium
---
## Ingredients
- 250 g of puff pastry
- 150 g of Pecorino Romano
- 100 g of Grana Padano
- 4 whole eggs + 1 egg yolk
## Method
1. Crack 3 eggs into a bowl, add the egg yolk, salt, and pepper, and beat with a fork.
2. Add the cheeses and mix.
3. Crack the remaining egg, separating the yolk from the egg whites.
4. Roll out the puff pastry into a thin sheet and cut out discs of 8 cm with a cookie cutter.
5. Place the cheese filling in the center of half of the discs, brush the edges with the lightly beaten egg white, and cover with the other half of the discs, pressing the edges to seal them.
6. Place the small pastries on the baking sheet lined with the appropriate paper, brush the surface with the egg yolk, and bake in the oven at 180 °C for 15-20 minutes.
